name: Missing Environment Variable
description: DATABASE_URL is not set in the production environment. The checkout API starts successfully but fails on the first database-dependent request.

production_error.error_message: Database connection failed: DATABASE_URL is not defined
production_error.stack_trace:
Error: DATABASE_URL is not defined
    at /app/server.js:15:19
    at Layer.handle [as handle_request] (/app/node_modules/express/lib/router/layer.js:95:5)
    at next (/app/node_modules/express/lib/router/route.js:144:13)

root_cause.summary: The DATABASE_URL environment variable was not set in the production deployment configuration.
root_cause.details: The checkout-api service starts without validating that required environment variables are present. When a checkout request arrives, the application attempts to read DATABASE_URL from process.env, finds it undefined, and throws an error. This is a configuration management issue — the variable was likely omitted during the last deployment or environment update.
root_cause.suggested_fix: Add DATABASE_URL to the deployment environment configuration. Consider adding startup validation to fail fast when required environment variables are missing.
